title: Control Room Operator Copilot

engineFeatures.meaning: narrow queries for context and evidence, with no free-form shell or query language
the specific records that justify a verdict
text fields an outsider can influence, treated as data

label: For "Control Room Operator Copilot": Help control-room operators find procedures, similar past events and switching sheets during an incident by answering from controlled documents and giving the evidence, without issuing or preparing live commands. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Paraphrasing switching steps.
